properties.description: $62.6 million in 2025-26 out of a $427.7 million total spend to continue construction on the Lake Macdonald Dam improvement project. The project involves strengthening the dam’s foundation, building a new concrete spillway and reconstructing the existing earth embankments. properties.description: $142.7 million in 2025-26 out of a $273.1 million total spend to finalise preconstruction activities and commence construction of the 109 kilometre Toowoomba to Warwick Pipeline.
